name: council
description: Run Codex council reviews with native agents, strict inline-or-explicit-file boundaries, broad-run gates, and synthesis.

interface.shortDescription: Run strictly bounded Codex reviewer-agent councils
interface.longDescription: Runs focused or broad Codex reviewer-agent councils. Inline text is the complete target unless the user supplies an @path, exact files, or a diff; Council must not search memory, repos, git history, prior sessions, Claude assets, or local files. It supervises reviewers, blocks unapproved broad runs, and returns one synthesized result.
defaultPrompt: Use $council to review this code or plan with best-fit reviewers; inline text is the full target.
Use $council all for a broad engineering and UX review after explicit approval.
Use $council debate to compare hard tradeoffs.
